summary: BioLineRx Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held September 23, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Israel time. Shareholders approved all five proxy proposals: re-election of Dr. Aharon Schwartz, Dr. Sandra Panem and Dr. Shaoyu Yan as Class III directors through 2029; an increase in authorized share capital with a corresponding Articles amendment; equity compensation to CEO Philip Serlin; option grants to certain directors; and reappointment of Kesselman Kesselman (PwC Israel) as auditors for fiscal 2026. No special-situation transaction, price, premium, advisor or regulatory clock is disclosed; the filing is a routine meeting-result notice incorporated by reference into effective shelf registration statements. The authorized-share-capital increase is the item worth monitoring, as it expands future issuance capacity and potential dilution rather than signaling any pending deal.
